_about: The Odia narration, one line per step. `or` is spoken and shown as the caption; `en` is only for whoever edits this file. Change any `or` line and re-run make_video.sh. Keep each line short: it is one caption on screen.

steps.or: ନମସ୍କାର! ଆସନ୍ତୁ, ‘ମୋ ଦୋକାନ’ ଦେଖିବା।
steps.en: Namaskar! Come, let us look at Mo Dokan.

steps.or: ଖାତା ଲେଖିବା, ଷ୍ଟକ ଗଣିବା, ଲାଭ ହିସାବ କରିବା — ସବୁ ଏବେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଫୋନରେ।
steps.en: Writing the ledger, counting stock, working out profit: all of it now on your phone.

steps.or: ପ୍ରଥମ ଥର, ଦୋକାନର ନାଁ ଆଉ ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର ଦେଇ ଖାତା ଖୋଲନ୍ତୁ।
steps.en: The first time, open an account with the shop's name and mobile number.

steps.or: କିଛି ଭୁଲ ହେଲେ, ସେହି ଘର ଲାଲ ହୋଇଯାଏ, ଆଉ କଣ ଠିକ କରିବେ ଲେଖା ଆସେ।
steps.en: If something is wrong, that box turns red and tells you what to fix.

steps.or: ତା’ପରେ ୟୁଜରନେମ ବା ମୋବାଇଲ ନମ୍ବର, ଆଉ ପାସୱାର୍ଡ ଦେଇ ଭିତରକୁ ଆସନ୍ତୁ।
steps.en: Then come in with your username or mobile number, and your password.

steps.or: ଖୋଲିଲେ ଦୁଇଟି ବଡ଼ ବଟନ — ସବୁଜ ‘ବିକ୍ରି’, ଆଉ ନୀଳ ‘କିଣା’।
steps.en: When it opens, two big buttons: green Sell, and blue Buy.

steps.or: ଉପରେ ଦେଖାଯାଏ, ଆଜି କେତେ ଟଙ୍କାର ବିକ୍ରି ହେଲା।
steps.en: At the top you see how much you sold today.

steps.or: ଗ୍ରାହକ ଆସିଲେ ‘ବିକ୍ରି’ ଦବାନ୍ତୁ। ବିଲ ତିନି ଉପାୟରେ ହୁଏ — କହି, ଫଟୋରୁ, କିମ୍ବା ଲେଖି।
steps.en: When a customer comes, press Sell. A bill can be made three ways: speaking, a photo, or writing.

steps.or: ମାଇକ ଦବାନ୍ତୁ। ଫୋନ ଟିକେ କମ୍ପିବ — ଅର୍ଥାତ ଶୁଣୁଛି।
steps.en: Press the mic. The phone buzzes a little, which means it is listening.

steps.or: ଯେମିତି ଦୋକାନ ପିଲାକୁ କୁହନ୍ତି, ସେମିତି ଜିନିଷର ନାଁ କୁହନ୍ତୁ।
steps.en: Say the items the way you would tell your shop helper.

steps.or: କେବଳ ନାଁ କହିଲେ ବି ଚଳିବ — ବାସମତୀ, ମାରି ଗୋଲ୍ଡ, ଟାଇଗର ବିସ୍କୁଟ।
steps.en: Just the names are enough: basmati, Marie Gold, Tiger biscuit.

steps.or: ଦାମ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଦୋକାନରୁ ନିଜେ ଆସେ। ହଳଦିଆ ଘରେ କେବଳ ପରିମାଣ ଭରନ୍ତୁ।
steps.en: The price comes from your shop by itself. Fill only the quantity in the yellow box.

steps.or: ଅଧା ବିଲ ଛାଡ଼ି ଅନ୍ୟ କାମକୁ ଗଲେ ବି ଚିନ୍ତା ନାହିଁ।
steps.en: No worry if you leave a bill half done and go to something else.

steps.or: ବିଲଟି ‘ସେଭ ହୋଇନାହିଁ’ ତାଲିକାରେ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରେ। ‘Continue’ ଦବାଇ ଯେଉଁଠି ଛାଡ଼ିଥିଲେ ସେଠୁ କରନ୍ତୁ।
steps.en: The bill waits under Not saved yet. Press Continue and carry on where you left off.

steps.or: ସବୁ ଭରିଗଲେ ‘Save’ ଦବାନ୍ତୁ। ବିଲ ସେଭ ହେଲା, ଷ୍ଟକ ନିଜେ କମିଗଲା।
steps.en: When it is all filled, press Save. The bill is saved and the stock goes down by itself.

steps.or: ପାଇକାରୀଠାରୁ ମାଲ ଆସିଲେ, ‘କିଣା’ ଦବାନ୍ତୁ।
steps.en: When stock arrives from the wholesaler, press Buy.

steps.or: ପାଇକାରୀ ବିଲର ଗୋଟିଏ ଫଟୋ ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।
steps.en: Take one photo of the wholesaler's bill.

steps.or: ଜିନିଷ, ପରିମାଣ ଆଉ କିଣା ଦର — ସବୁ ଫଟୋରୁ ନିଜେ ପଢ଼ିନିଏ।
steps.en: Items, quantity and the buying rate: it reads them all from the photo by itself.

steps.or: ପାଖରେ ବିକ୍ରି ଦାମ ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତି ଜିନିଷରେ କେତେ ଲାଭ, ସଙ୍ଗେ ସଙ୍ଗେ ଦେଖାଯାଏ।
steps.en: Write your selling price beside it. The profit on each item shows straight away.

steps.or: ଖାଲି ‘ବିସ୍କୁଟ’ ଲେଖାଥିଲେ, କେଉଁ ବିସ୍କୁଟ, ଗୋଟିଏ ଛୁଆଁରେ ବାଛନ୍ତୁ।
steps.en: If only 'biscuit' is written, pick which biscuit with one touch.

steps.or: ନୂଆ ଜିନିଷ ନିଜେ ଷ୍ଟକରେ ଯୋଡ଼ି ହୋଇଯାଏ। ‘Save’ ଦବାନ୍ତୁ।
steps.en: A new item is added to your stock by itself. Press Save.

steps.or: ‘ମୋ ମାଲ’ରେ ସବୁ ଜିନିଷ — କେତେ ଅଛି, କିଣା ଦାମ, ବିକ୍ରି ଦାମ, ଲାଭ — ଏକାଠି।
steps.en: My stock has every item together: how much is left, buying price, selling price, profit.

steps.or: ଜିନିଷ ଛୁଇଁଲେ ଦାମ ବଦଳାଇ ପାରିବେ। କମ ଥିବା ମାଲ ହଳଦିଆରେ ଦେଖାଯାଏ।
steps.en: Touch an item to change its price. Stock running low shows in yellow.

steps.or: ‘ହିସାବ’ରେ ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ — କେଉଁ ଜିନିଷ ବେଶି ଟଙ୍କା ଦିଏ, କେଉଁଟା ବେଶି ବିକେ।
steps.en: In Report, see which item brings the most money, and which sells the most.

steps.or: ଆଉ କେଉଁ ଜିନିଷରେ ସବୁଠୁ ବେଶି ଲାଭ — ସବୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ପୃଷ୍ଠାରେ।
steps.en: And which item gives the most profit: all on one page.

steps.or: ଖାତା ଲେଖିବାର ଝଞ୍ଝଟ ଶେଷ। ସମୟ ବଞ୍ଚେ, ହିସାବ ଠିକ ରହେ।
steps.en: The trouble of writing the ledger is over. You save time, and the accounts stay right.

steps.or: ‘ମୋ ଦୋକାନ’ — ଆଜି ହିଁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ।
steps.en: Mo Dokan: start today.
